card.name: Space before a dose number
card.fires_on: The bare space token right before a dose figure such as 10 or 5 in fluoxetine and similar antidepressant labels, after 'dose of' or 'range of'. Also fires on 'represent' in a sentence about bipolar conversion.

modes.label: Space before dose
modes.description: A lone space after 'dose of', 'range of' or 'is' that comes just before a mg/day amount.
modes.example: patients were administered fluoxetine tablets doses in the range of<< >>10 to 60 mg/day

modes.label: Represent in bipolar sentence
modes.description: The verb 'represent' in the sentence asking whether symptoms signal a switch to bipolar disorder.
modes.example: Whether any of the symptoms described above<< represent>> such a conversion is unknown.

card.plain: It marks the spot just before a daily dose amount in antidepressant dosing text.
